component.name: Box
component.description: The foundational layout primitive. A polymorphic container that applies spacing tokens via the padding props and controls overflow clipping. Everything else in the system can be placed inside a Box.

useWhen: Wrapping content that needs padding without imposing flex or grid layout
Providing semantic HTML structure via the as prop (section, article, aside, main)
Creating a padded surface or card-like region before Card is available

notFor.case: Using Box to apply flex or grid layout
notFor.because: Box has no layout opinions beyond padding. It is not a flex container.
notFor.note: Use Stack for vertical flex layout or Inline for horizontal flex layout

patterns.name: padded-surface
patterns.description: A Box wrapping a Stack to create a padded vertical content region.

patterns.name: page-main
patterns.description: Box rendered as the page's <main> landmark — the polymorphic as prop emits a real <main> element. Exactly one per route (ADR-011).

patterns.name: page-header
patterns.description: Box rendered as the page's <header> landmark. Use AppHeader directly when the full header component is available; any child <nav> needs a unique aria-label.

patterns.name: page-section
patterns.description: Box rendered as a <section> landmark. aria-labelledby must point to the visible Heading id; use aria-label only when there is no visible heading. Add paddingY for vertical rhythm. A .container div inside handles max-width and grid margins.

patterns.name: page-footer
patterns.description: Box rendered as the page's <footer> (contentinfo landmark). One per page; a .container div inside handles max-width and grid margins. Pair background='inverted' with borderTop='inverted' for a footer that separates from an inverted-background section above it.

patterns.name: container
patterns.description: Box with className='container' to center content in a section. The .container global class applies max-width + grid margin (packages/components/src/styles/grid.css). Prefer this over a raw <div className='container'>.

useWhen.default: A generic padded container. Rendered as div by default; override with the as prop for semantic HTML.

useWhen.canvas: Flat surface matching the page background — same fill as Card's default variant, for a Box standing in as a plain surface or as the page's own wrapper.
useWhen.inverted: Dark surface for CTA banners, footers, or other sections that invert against the page's default theme.
useWhen.transparent: Explicitly no fill — lets the parent surface show through.
useWhen.elevated: Raised surface with a token-backed radius, for a Box standing in as a card-like region (e.g. Storybook demo chrome) before Card is warranted.

useWhen.default: A subtle top border for separating a Box from the content above it on the page's default theme.
useWhen.inverted: A top border for separating an inverted-background Box (e.g. a dark footer) from the section above it.

rules.case: Nesting Boxes purely to add padding when a single Box with paddingX/paddingY suffices
rules.because: Unnecessary nesting inflates the DOM and makes spacing harder to reason about
rules.do: Use the paddingX and paddingY props on a single Box to apply asymmetric spacing
